title: Cutover and rollback plan
summary: The October 5 cutover is a separate approval gate with a Dan and Mary provider decision, credential swap, preflight, browser and API verification, and immediate rollback to the preserved current host.
evidence: The new host remains staging-only until all launch gates pass and Cole separately approves cutover.
The current host stays online and unchanged as the rollback target.
Dan and Mary choose the permanent application provider account and credential at cutover.
The approved provider credential must be swapped and verified without exposure to builders or receipts.
Rollback triggers include health, error, citation, authentication, integrity, and latency failures.
DNS and proxy values, final backup, data delta, and browser verification are required before completion.
limitations: This receipt documents the plan only. It does not authorize or claim a production cutover or provider credential change.
